Class ServerConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.config.ServerConfig
public class ServerConfig extends Object
Server-authoritative spawn settings. The googly-eye chance lives here (not in the bundled eye datapack), so admins can tune how common eyes are — globally and per entity — without touching the shipped eye-definition datapacks. Those JSONs only decide where eyes go and whether an entity is eligible at all (their enabled flag is an authoritative hard on/off, applied by EyeConfigModel.RuntimeConfig.isUsable); this class decides how often an eligible entity actually rolls eyes. Also hosts the picker's opt-in gate for the destructive /sg spawnall grid (ALLOW_SPAWN_ALL, enforced by the server command).

      public static boolean isSpawnExcluded(net.minecraft.resources.Identifier entityType)
